title: Global stalk tensor homology computed from a prescribed K-flat relative representative
statement: Let X,Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Y a morphism, K a cochain complex of O_X-modules, and y∈X. Write A=O_Y,f(y), G_y for the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], and choose a derived category of A-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let P be a K-flat complex of f inverse image O_Y-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] with a quasi-isomorphism q:P→res(K) along the canonical ring sheaf map [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. For every f inverse image O_Y-module sheaf F, there exists one A-module M such that for every integer i the underlying abelian-group stalk at y of H^i(Tot(P tensor F[0])) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is isomorphic to the underlying abelian group of H^i(Q(restrict along f.stalkMap y of G_y K) tensor in D(A) M[0]). M can be taken to be the actual stalk of F transported along the canonical inverse-image ring stalk isomorphism. No local model or boundedness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tags 06YB (lemma-check-K-flat-stalks), 08CG and 09U9; Modules Tag 01AG; Sheaves Tags 008H and 0098; comparison step in Tag 0B6G condition (3). Sources checked online.

proof.text: Construct the ringed space Z on X with its inverse-image ring sheaf. The stalk pullback isomorphism followed by the stalk of sheafification gives an isomorphism e:O_Y,f(y)≅O_Z,y. Let S be the actual module stalk functor followed by restriction along e. Set M=S(F), using the actual stalk rather than choosing an existence witness.

The underlying abelian-group stalk functor is exact. The module forgetful functor preserves finite limits and colimits and the forgetful functor from stalk modules reflects them, so the module stalk functor is exact as well. Restriction of scalars is exact. Map the given quasi-isomorphism q through S and then Q to obtain an isomorphism. Compose with Q applied to the relative inverse-image stalk restriction comparison. This identifies Q(S(P)) with Q of the f.stalkMap-restricted stalk complex of K.

Apply the K-flat tensor stalk homology comparison with Z,y,e,P,F. Tensor the previous derived isomorphism with the identity of M[0], apply degree-i derived homology and forget scalars. Compose these actual isomorphisms. The one constructed M is used in every degree.

theorem relativeTensor_stalk_global_homology_iso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (y : X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)))]
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf))) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf) P)
    (q : P ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (Modules.tensorPullbackRingMap f))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) (hq : QuasiIso q) :
    ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
            (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf)),
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)), ∀ i : ℤ,
          Nonempty ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X.carrier ⋙
            TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} y).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
                ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
                  ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)
                  (@MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory
                    (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf)))).homology i)) ≅
            (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) i).obj
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                    (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap y).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
                      (.up ℤ)).obj
                        (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace y).mapHomologicalComplex
                          (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ⊗
                    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                      (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) 0).obj M)))
